newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 16.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Government says prefers Lagardere bid for Thomson, to create defence electronics industrial group able to compete with world leaders.

-- Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer says in an interview that he expects EMU will start on time, in 1999, provided no surprise obstacles rise. He adds that eligibility for joining EMU will be subject not just to meeting Maastricht treaty criteria, but should also depend on a country's long-term ability to implement financial discipline.
-- Air France to announce alliance with Delta Airlines and Continental Airlines which includes sharing Air France hub at Charles de Gaulle airport, flight code sharing and joint marketing.
-- Law on shorter work hours designed to avoid job cuts to be implemented from today on.
